verdict.rationale: An official desktop app exists: the docs ship Linux .deb, .rpm and AppImage builds, and a runtime probe lists macOS and Windows apps. The desktop app can also let Bots run approval-gated commands on the local machine and route egress through it. Nothing shows OS-level shortcuts or access to what is on the user's screen; the Agent Computer view shows the Bot's cloud desktop, not the user's. Missing for 10: global/OS-level keyboard shortcuts, screen-content capture or awareness of the local desktop, independent hands-on corroboration of desktop-app integration.
